Can you tell me how to kill the lights in my room?

If you mean turn them off: use the wall switch, lamp switch, or your smart-home app/voice assistant.

If the switch doesn’t work, unplug the lamp or turn off the relevant circuit breaker only if you know which circuit it is and can do so safely.
